# Contributing to Awesome Claude Widgets

Thanks for wanting to add something to the list.

## Ground rules

- Check that the widget is not already listed.
- One widget per recommendation.

## How to recommend a widget

Use the issue form; do not open a pull request. A bot validates the form, it does
not judge the widget.

Even though the widgets themselves may be written partly or wholly by a coding agent,
widget recommendations must be created by human beings.

## Other contributions

Treat the maintainers as human beings. Issues are triaged by humans every week.

1. Open a general issue
2. Describe your idea
